claims.text: Nolan is senior author of 'Improved instrumental techniques, including isotopic analysis, applicable to the characterization of unusual materials with potential relevance to aerospace forensics', Progress in Aerospace Sciences 128 (2022) 100788, with Jacques F. Vallee, Sizun Jiang and Larry G. Lemke.
Vallee is second author of the Progress in Aerospace Sciences 128 (2022) 100788 instrumental analysis of the Council Bluffs material.
Lemke is a co-author of Progress in Aerospace Sciences 128 (2022) 100788 with Nolan, Vallee and Jiang.

Nolan, Vallee, Jiang and Lemke published 'Improved instrumental techniques, including isotopic analysis, applicable to the characterization of unusual materials with potential relevance to aerospace forensics' in Progress in Aerospace Sciences 128:100788 (2022).
Jiang is third author of Progress in Aerospace Sciences 128 (2022) 100788.

edges.label: Senior author of the first peer-reviewed UAP materials analysis
edges.note: Progress in Aerospace Sciences 128:100788, applying SIMS and MIBI at 200 nm lateral resolution to the Council Bluffs material.

edges.label: Both at SRI International in the early 1970s
edges.note: Vallee joined Engelbart's Augmentation Research Center at SRI in 1971, in the same institution and period as Puthoff's psychoenergetics programme; Vallee was also consulted on classified remote-viewing research.

b.label: Nolan, Vallee, Jiang & Lemke (2022), Progress in Aerospace Sciences 128:100788

edges.label: Co-author and source of the sample and its case file
edges.note: Vallee supplied both the physical material and the 45-year documentary case record - newspaper reports, police photographs, fire-department accounts - that makes the analysis interpretable.

edges.label: NIDS consultant and Bigelow Aerospace scientific advisory board member
edges.note: Vallee's advisory position places the keeper of the largest private materials collection inside the Bigelow ecosystem that produced BAASS and the AAWSAP contract.

b.label: Nolan, Vallee, Jiang & Lemke (2022), Progress in Aerospace Sciences 128:100788

edges.label: NASA Ames aerospace engineer supplying the exclusion arguments
edges.note: Lemke's engineering judgement underpins the rejection of reentry-debris and aircraft-component hypotheses on thermal-history and materials-selection grounds.

edges.label: Isotopics is the falsifiable test
edges.note: The Nolan-Vallee methodology paper specifies isotope ratio measurement as the discriminating test; the chemistry domain is where that test is run.

a.label: Nolan, Vallee, Jiang & Lemke (2022), Progress in Aerospace Sciences 128:100788

edges.label: Establishes the standard the government's own holdings have never met
edges.note: A published sample, a published method, a published elimination of alternatives, and a stated residual. No government-held UAP material has ever been subjected to anything comparable in public.

a.label: Nolan, Vallee, Jiang & Lemke (2022), Progress in Aerospace Sciences 128:100788

b.label: Nolan Laboratory, Stanford University School of Medicine

edges.label: Analysis performed with MIBI, a Stanford-developed instrument
edges.note: Multiplexed ion beam imaging, developed by Angelo, Bendall and Nolan for tissue biology, resolved the sample at 200 nm laterally and 5 nm in depth - the technique's first application to alleged UAP material.

edges.label: Exploitation begins with characterisation
edges.note: Materials characterisation is the first step of any exploitation workflow and the only step whose outputs have been released - so far all conventional.

b.label: Nolan, Vallee, Jiang & Lemke (2022), Progress in Aerospace Sciences 128:100788

edges.label: Instrument operator and third author
edges.note: Jiang, then of the Nolan laboratory, ran the multiplexed ion beam imaging that produced the incomplete-mixing result.
